messages:
nora: opened a docs PR to add Acadia-13B int8 details + a short migration checklist and a tiny example for streaming embeddings. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5012
tariq: can you paste the numbers you used for the limits/bench section and the hardware? want to make sure we don't accidentally overpromise.
kevin: bench run on 1x a100-80g: p50 @512 tokens ~42ms (batch=4), sustained throughput ~155 tok/s (batch=8). memory resident ~43GB with int8 Q4. notes in gist: https://gist.github.com/kevin/acadia-5012-bench
sam: link-checker flagged a relative link in migration checklist: `../models/acadia/overview.md` -> 404. swap to canonical `/models/acadia` or use doc helper.
link-bot: Link check failed: /docs/models/acadia -> 404
nora: thanks, will update to `/models/acadia` and add a redirect entry for the old slug. also adding a short runtime compatibility note for older runtimes.
tariq: recommended phrasing for comp row: `Runtime < 3.1: int8 artifacts (KV v2) are unsupported. Requests will automatically fallback to Acadia-13B-fp16. Upgrade runtime to enable int8.` keep it brief.
kevin: also in the migration checklist add: how to force fp16 if you need parity testing: set `model: "acadia-13b-fp16"` in SDK calls, examples below. and change all "quantized" mentions to "int8 (Q4)" for clarity.
nora: dropping snippets here for PR, feel free to edit:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
# batched streaming embeddings example
texts = ["doc1", "doc2", "doc3", "doc4"]
resp = client.embeddings.create(model="acadia-13b-int8", input=texts, batch_size=4)
for item in resp.data:
    print(len(item.embedding))
```
```js
import Redwood from '@redwoodai/sdk'
const client = new Redwood()
const resp = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'acadia-13b-int8', input: ['a','b','c'], batchSize: 4 })
console.log(resp.data.map(d => d.embedding.length))
```
kevin: tiny nit: in the migration guide under "known diffs" add a line about small tokenization/output variance when switching fp16<->int8 (~3-6%). saves support tickets.
tariq: also call out sequence guidance: `max sequence: 8192 (tested); recommended sustained <= 4096 for predictable P50` and mark it as tested on a100.

sam: LGTM overall. I'll do a formal review tomorrow morning. nora, can you merge after approvals and drop a short note in #release-war-room?
nora: yup will merge after sam, will announce in release-war-room once live. thanks!
